response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose calibrstatus is NULL form their own group, since the request asks for each calibration status and does not say to drop missing values.
The number of telescopes is COUNT(*) over the filtered rows, because telescregistry is the primary key of telescopes, so each row is one telescope.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat a missing calibration status as not a status, so exclude telescopes with NULL calibrstatus from the per-status results.
alternatives.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 AND calibrstatus IS NOT NULL GROUP BY calibrstatus;
